teaser: An essay about burning out on AI that I could not buy, three paragraphs and a subscription; and why my two years of AI were the opposite.
core_idea: A Business Insider essay on burning out after two years in AI showed three paragraphs, adverts and a subscription offer, so it could be neither bought alone nor answered; the newsroom's model earns trust by reading and charges for what is read; and Dinis's own two years in AI were his most productive and empowered, hard but in control, with Wardley maps showing the game.
